What we manufacture

Why engineers specify Sinetrac

Cost effectiveness without cutting on quality.

Copper is increasingly rare in this market — most manufacturers have switched to aluminium windings to cut cost. Sinetrac, alongside a handful of established names in this field, still winds every transformer in copper only, at a competitive price.

  • Windings, wiring & terminations — copper only, no aluminium substitution
  • Electronic circuitry built on standard European & Indian components (Philips ICs, Semikron IGBTs) — no unproven low-cost imports
  • Every unit tested on double-voltage & frequency rigs and full-load test benches before dispatch
  • Approved by E-in-C’s Branch and Central, Western, Northern, Southern & SW Commands

Manufacturing at a glance

1987

Chime Electronics established.

1995 – 1997

Sinetrac brand registered; first supply to MES.

2001 – 2002

E-in-C’s Branch approval for stabilizers, UPS & chargers; phase sequence correctors developed for MES pump houses.

2006

Both manufacturing units consolidated at the new Bawana, Delhi plant.

2015 – 2019

Solar Hybrid UPS approved; Command-level Group 1 approvals; QCI certification & GeM registration.

Inside the plant

Built and proven at Bawana, Delhi.

Vacuum Impregnation Plant

Transformer windings are vacuum-impregnated for moisture resistance and long service life under continuous duty.

Double Voltage & Frequency Test

Every transformer is proof-tested at double the rated voltage and frequency before it is approved for assembly.

Full Load Test Bench

Finished units are run at full rated load to confirm voltage regulation and thermal performance under real conditions.
